detect.note: PKHeX reads the general block's size and magic from slot B, the slot a game saves to first. It tries Diamond and Pearl's size and Platinum's first.

pk4.note: A stored Pokémon after pk45-crypt, its blocks in the order A, B, C, D.

ranges.name: ROM code
ranges.note: 7 for HeartGold, 8 for SoulSilver. PKHeX reads the game from it.

ranges.name: Items pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 162 slots, one for each item the pocket takes.

ranges.name: Key items pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 38, one for each key item.

ranges.name: TMs and HMs pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 100, one for each TM and HM.

ranges.name: Medicine pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 38, one for each medicine.

ranges.name: Poké Balls pocket
ranges.note: One slot for each ball, the Apricorn balls included.

ranges.name: Battle items pocket
ranges.note: PKHeX reads the first 13 slots, one for each battle item. The pocket's other slots run to 0x0DDC.

ranges.name: Event flags
ranges.note: 2,912 flags.

ranges.name: Pokédex owned flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 493. The last byte holds the Deoxys forms seen, with the last byte of the seen flags.

ranges.name: Pokédex seen flags
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n, for 1 to 493. The last byte holds the Deoxys forms seen, with the last byte of the owned flags.

ranges.name: Pokédex first gender seen
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n: 0 for male, 1 for female.

ranges.name: Pokédex second gender seen
ranges.note: Bit n-1 is National Pokédex number n. It differs from the first gender's bit once both genders are seen.

ranges.name: Daycare Pokémon
ranges.note: Encrypted like a boxed Pokémon (pk45-crypt).

ranges.name: Accessory counts
ranges.note: Four bits per accessory that can be held more than once.

ranges.name: Accessories owned
ranges.note: One bit per accessory held once at most.

ranges.name: Backdrop positions
ranges.note: 18 for a backdrop not unlocked.

ranges.name: Groups
ranges.note: The player's group, the group the player is in, then four from other players.

ranges.name: Records
ranges.note: Encrypted. PKHeX decrypts them.

ranges.name: Seals
ranges.note: How many of each seal the player has.

ranges.name: Roamer location
ranges.note: Raikou, Entei, Latias, then Latios.

ranges.name: Mystery Gift received flags
ranges.note: Flag 2047 is the deliveryman being at the Pokémon Center.

bits.name: Map unlocked: 0 Johto, 1 Johto and more, 2 Johto and Kanto

ranges.name: Pokégear phone contacts
ranges.note: One contact a byte, by PKHeX's PokegearNumber, and 0xFF after the last.

ranges.name: Apricorns
ranges.note: How many of each Apricorn the player has, by index. PKHeX reads them one at a time and gives no count. 7 is the number of Apricorn kinds.

ranges.name: Pokéwalker courses unlocked
ranges.note: One flag a course, 27 of them in the Japanese games.

ranges.name: Save counter
ranges.note: PKHeX compares it as the minor counter. HeartGold and SoulSilver have no major counter: the 4 bytes PKHeX reads as one are the block's last data bytes.

ranges.name: Magic
ranges.note: 0x20060623, or 0x20070903 in the Korean games.

ranges.name: Box Pokémon (decoded in box spaces)
ranges.note: Each box is 30 Pokémon and 0x10 bytes of padding, to the next 0x1000.

ranges.name: Boxes changed since the last save
ranges.note: One bit a box. PKHeX sets all 18 when it writes a save, so the game saves every box.

ranges.name: Box names
ranges.note: Up to 8 characters.

ranges.name: Save counter
ranges.note: PKHeX compares it as the minor counter. HeartGold and SoulSilver have no major counter: the 4 bytes PKHeX reads as one are the block's last data bytes.

ranges.name: Magic
ranges.note: 0x20060623, or 0x20070903 in the Korean games.

wallpaper.note: HeartGold and SoulSilver store their special wallpapers 16 higher than PKHeX numbers them.

ball.note: HeartGold and SoulSilver show ball-hgss instead where it's set, for a Pokémon caught there.

location.note: HeartGold and SoulSilver write the met location to met-location-extended too, and keep Faraway Place here for a place Diamond and Pearl don't have.

hatch-counter.note: An egg keeps its hatch counter in the friendship byte.
